description: Find leads by person, location, company, industry, tech stack, funding, traffic, hiring and HQ filters, optionally within one company. Returns name, job title, seniority, department, location, LinkedIn profile, skills and company details; paged up to 500,000 pages of 10–100 leads. 2 points per returned record.
